text:
maria: quick q — we need to pick how the audit trail surface differs for org admins vs regular workspace members. thinking: add a visibility enum + redaction level and sign events with KMS. any concerns? :thinking_face:

dan: +1 to enum. also we need scoped token claims for auditors (e.g., scope=read:audits:tenant:<id>) so we can gate reads at the auth layer. main risk is accidentally returning full request payloads in member-facing views.

oliver: from product side the customer export UI shows a 'who' column. compliance sometimes requires the real actor for investigations, but we shouldn't expose that to members. propose separation: storage preserves full actor id, surface applies mask unless viewer_role in [admin, security, auditor].

jamie: legal note — for incident response we need unredacted actor ids retained for X days (we have retention policy), and we may need to provide them on request. storage vs UI surface distinction sounds right. also watch PII fields in event.payload.

dan: implementation sketch: storage model keeps full event JSON; schema adds fields: visibility, redaction_level, viewer_role, kms_signature. token service enforces scoped tokens and injects viewer_role from claims. default surface rules apply at query layer.

audit-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/512 — draft schema, migration plan, and lint checks. CI shows schema-lint failing on enum names 'meta-only' vs 'meta'.

maria: sample schema snippet I dropped in the PR for discussion:

```json
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "tid_123",
  "actor": { "id": "user_456", "role": "user", "masked": true },
  "visibility": "full|masked|meta",
  "redaction_level": "none|partial|identifiers-only",
  "kms_signature": "base64sig==",
  "stored_at": "2026-03-19T22:00:00Z"
}
```

jamie: note — retention/holding order interplay: if we keep full actor in storage but mask on surface, we must log who unmasked an event (audit the auditors). add an unmasking_event record.

dan: agreed. add unmask_event to schema and record acting_principal + reason + timestamp. also KMS-sign the unmask event chain.

oliver: UI impact: export preview should show masked values by default and a gated 'request full view' flow for admins that records consent. also surface a column that indicates redaction_level so customers know what they're getting.

maria: ops decision proposal: default mask for roles: member, readonly, support; full for admin, security, auditor. allow tenant opt-in to expose more. followups: dan -> token + storage, jamie -> legal retention notes, oliver -> UI stubs. i'll assign after lunch. :memo: :lock:

oliver: can we also add a small migration guide for customers with on-prem/private deployments? behaviour differences could surprise them.

maria: yes, will include migration notes and a CLI toggle for private installs.

jamie: :thumbsup: please include KMS key rotation and emergency unwrap playbook in the doc.

dan: I'll start the token changes and a feature-flagged rollout. will ping infra for canary run.

maria: thanks everyone — will add issues and assign owners. :eyes:
